## About
Bartley Service Co. is a family owned and operated shop in Pflugerville. We handle a full range of truck and auto repair, along with hydraulic sales and service and welding and fabrication.
Our aim is simple. We want each job done right and done well the first time around, whether it's an oil change on your car or a custom hydraulic hose for your equipment.

## Services
- Car and medium-duty truck repair: Brakes, alignment and front end, air conditioning, heating and cooling, electrical work, exhaust, shocks and struts, oil changes and factory-scheduled maintenance for all cars and medium-duty trucks.
- Tires: We carry Bridgestone and Firestone tires.
- Hydraulic repair and assembly: Pump repair, cylinder repair, custom-designed cylinders, and electro-hydraulic and electro-pneumatic work.
- Custom hose assembly: Custom hydraulic hoses built in the shop, with fittings, adapters and accessories.
- Welding and fabrication: Welding and fabrication work, including custom welding jobs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on regular cars or just trucks?
A: Both. We do repair and maintenance on all cars and medium-duty trucks.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Call us at 512-990-9888 or email info@austintruck-autorepair.com.
